dct_description_sm: The NCDB contains nationwide tract-level data from the 1970, 1980, 1990 and 2000 decennial censuses.   CDROM is required to use the data. CD purchased by MPI in 2011 and has been misplaced, though if found it won't run on PCs running Windows 7 or newer.   Copy of data is located at Q:\Venture\MasterData\Source\NCDB.
dct_rights_sm: The Martin Prosperity Institute makes its research data available for sharing with the broader social science community. The MPI is pleased to share research data under the certain conditions. By downloading this data, you agree to the following: Your use of the data must be correctly cited as the property of the Martin Prosperity Institute and its principal investigators. You must use the citation provided for each study in the MPI Dataverse. The data must be used for academic use only. Commercial use is prohibited. You may not share our data with anyone else. All requests to share this data must come to the Martin Prosperity Institute. Direct your questions about these Terms of Use to the MPI Data Librarian, Kim Silk at kimberly.silk@rotman.utoronto.ca.
